scripts.compile:webview: npm run compile:webview:chart && npm run compile:webview:results && npm run compile:webview:plugins && npm run compile:webview:profiler && npm run compile:webview:layers
scripts.check: tsc -p ./ --noEmit && tsc -p webview/chart/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p webview/results/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p webview/plugins/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p webview/profiler/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p webview/layers/tsconfig.json --noEmit

notes.merge: Change the existing activity-bar view axis.layers from an implicit TreeView to type webview. Keep name Layers and icon media/views/layers.svg. Set retainContextWhenHidden true. Do not add a second axis.layers entry. onView:axis.layers is already an activation event.
notes.scripts: Add compile:webview:layers and append it to compile:webview. Append tsc -p webview/layers/tsconfig.json --noEmit to check. Vite IIFE global is AxisLayersWebview; outDir is dist/webview/layers (main.js + main.css).
notes.vscodeignore: Whitelist dist/webview/layers the same nested way as profiler: ignore the directory, then un-ignore only main.js and main.css. Do not un-ignore the directory wholesale.
notes.wiring: Call registerLayersStudio(context) from activate INSTEAD of window.createTreeView for axis.layers only. In registerAxisTreeViews, skip LAYERS_VIEW_ID (keep Library and Scripts tree views). Do not delete LayersTreeProvider or edit layers.ts. registerLayersStudio uses window.registerWebviewViewProvider('axis.layers', provider, { webviewOptions: { retainContextWhenHidden: true } }) and refreshes when the active editor changes. The Open chart button posts { type: 'layers.openChart' }; the panel runs commands.executeCommand('axis.openChart').
notes.coverage: Add 'views/layers-panel.ts' to EXCLUDE in scripts/check-coverage.mjs (same reason as views/profiler-panel.ts). Do not exclude layers-messages.ts or layers-html.ts.
notes.protocol: Webview posts { type: 'layers.ready' } and { type: 'layers.openChart' }. Host posts { type: 'layers.set', snapshot } with five sections in Scripts, Panes, Overlays, On-chain, Drawings order. Do not add these types to axis.webview.v1 ALL_MESSAGE_TYPES.
